prompt: What is the title of the song that had the second highest record sales recorded on the Discography of American Historical Recordings in the same year that Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica?
answer: Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica in **1917**. In the Discography of American Historical Recordings’ sales records for that year, the song with the **second-highest sales** was **“Good-Bye Broadway, Hello France.”**
